_comment: Offline demo of refusals. 'flash' refuses anything. An independent judge (oai-pro) triages: a benign task (kill a dev server on a port) is an over-refusal, so flash is retired and 'mini' does it; a harmful task (keylogger) is a legitimate refusal, so relay stops instead of model-shopping.

plan.command: lsof -ti tcp:8000 | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; echo 'port 8000 free'

mini.final: Freed port 8000 and wrote serve.sh to start the dev server in the background.
